question: What quantity of recitation is declared the chief practice?
premises: Recitation is prescribed as a practice.
This number is remembered as chief.
inference: A recitation of eight thousand and more is regarded as the chief practice.
uncertainties: aṣṭa+adhika sahasram may mean eight thousand or a thousand plus eight depending on context
plain_english: And a recitation of more than eight thousand is remembered as this chief practice.
